name: Coastnet
summary: Sunshine + Fraser Coasts dialup ISP (PPP/UUCP, POPs Nambour + Maryborough, ~1997); gone by ~2003; coastnet.net.au later reused by an unrelated Gold Coast ISP.

events.details: Dialup ISP; earliest coastnet.net.au capture 9 Jan 1998.
Last capture of the original Nambour ISP content ~Sep 2002; domain then lapsed (no captures Sep 2002 - Aug 2006).
source: Wayback CDX coastnet.net.au: small ISP pages to 20020924, gap to 20060822

events.details: coastnet.net.au was later reused by an unrelated Gold Coast ISP, CoastNet Pty Ltd (ADSL2+/wireless/VoIP; site copyright 2009-2025) — a distinct entity, not a continuation of the Nambour dialup ISP.
